svg.text: claudia — styles round: “All styles” gets an Edit beside Rename
Proposal for review — nothing is built. One dialog, shared by all three apps (the host supplies the noun and which controls apply).
A · The list, with Edit beside Rename
Unchanged dialog; one more link per row. Hidden for readers, like Rename.
Only the 1 waiting for a name
a note to the reader or co-author
B · Edit pressed — the dialog widens and the editor opens beside the list
Same controls as Format ▸ Edit this style…; every change applies to all uses at once.
a note to the reader or co-author
A change here changes all 7 paragraphs that use Quote.
How it reads in the document
The sample reads as it will in the text.
Words of someone else, set apart.
Edit sits beside Rename in every row (“Name it” for a style that still waits for its name). Readers do not see it — same rule as Rename.
Edit opens the editor the Format ▸ Edit this style… popover already has, on the style you picked. Nothing is selected in the document, so there is no “this paragraph only”: a change always
The dialog grows from 520 to about 760 px on the first Edit, the list narrows to name + count. Under about 700 px wide the editor replaces the list, with a “← Styles” button back.
Changes apply at once, each is one history step and can be undone; so no OK / Cancel — the Close button just closes.
Same dialog in all three apps. The host decides the noun (paragraph, shape, cell) and which controls exist: a picture has none, so Edit is not offered for a style only a picture uses.
